tools.name: validate_zpl
tools.description: Check ZPL syntax and count labels (copies from ^PQ included) without rendering. Free, no API key, no quota.

tools.name: preview_zpl
tools.description: Render up to 2 unique labels as PNG images to check how they look. No API key needed (rate limited); no quota used.

tools.name: convert_zpl_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert ZPL labels to a PDF (or PNG/JPEG on Pro and above) and return a download URL valid for 15 minutes. tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: Status of a conversion started with convert_zpl_to_pdf, and a fresh download URL when it is completed. Needs an API key.

tools.name: get_account_usage
tools.description: Plan, PDFs left this billing period, labels allowed per PDF and renewal date of the account that owns the API key.
